name: catalogue-health
title: Catalogue search health
subtitle: Fictional demo until you replace the records

sections.title: Owners and coverage
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,records,searchable,review_due,test_cases,open_tasks from catalogue_health order by code

sections.title: Stale sources and overdue work
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due_on nulls first,code,reference

sections.title: Recorded search gaps
sections.sql: select * from zero_results order by attempts desc,code,query
sections.note: Only recorded queries are included. Searches are not logged automatically.
